🧗 YOLO Climbing Hold Annotator

📋 Instructions:

  • Load Image: Click "Choose Image" and select a climbing wall photo
  • Draw Boxes: Click and drag on the image to draw bounding boxes around holds
  • Delete Box: Click "Undo Last Box" or press 'U' key
  • Save Labels: Click "Download Labels" to save the .txt file (same name as image)
  • Next Image: Load next image and repeat
